[SWS_CM_10445] SomeIpBurstTransmission

shall be applied for this number of segments. If not configured,
SeparationTime
will
be applied between all frames.
⌋
Note:
If
burstSize
is set on receiver side it can be used to optimize buffer handling
for reception of bursts.
